name: com.nexoider.coreaiunity
description: Unity layer for CoreAI: unified MEAI pipeline, CoreAISettingsAsset, LLM backend switching, WorldCommand tool, CoreAi singleton API, Control API (StopAgent, ClearContext, OnToolExecuted), ForcedToolMode, per-agent MaxOutputTokens, TryRepairToolName, HTTP retry with Retry-After, memory store propagation fix for HTTP modes, context budget/transcript/FileConversationSummaryStore, optional LLM-assisted context compaction (v1.5.3), thread-safety audit hardening (v1.5.5). Portable LLM pipeline classes moved to CoreAI.Core. Depends on com.nexoider.coreai 1.5.5+.
